description: Personal test run, not for PRs. GPT-6 Luna on 5 small mazes (V01 empty room, V02 winding corridor, V03 multi path, V04 single key, V05 single switch), one serial API worker, $1 spend cap. Launch: CLOUD_LOGGING=1 RUN_CONFIG=gridworld/fixtures/run_config.local_luna_5_mazes.json MANIFEST=gridworld/fixtures/manifest.json DIFFICULTY_MAX=1000 MAX_RUN_DURATION=2h ./launch_distributed.sh
